It’s that easy

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Teslaconomics (@Teslaconomics); megjelent: 2026-10-22T23:37:43+00:00; link: https://x.com/Teslaconomics/status/2113414527106843129; média: 1 kép]
I just bought my kids 2 Garmin watches with one text.

"Grok Bot, order me two vivosmart 5s for my two kids shipped to my home"

It already knows my address and my card. It found the right size and color, did the checkout and placed the order.

Just a minute later, I had the confirmation... I never opened a website.

This is the new way to shop.
